H1.quote: no medication or supplement is recorded as overlapping the trial, not checked with the owner
H1.why: The summary drops the confounder line's scope words "in this window". The bottom line "cannot be confirmed clean" is kept, and so is "not checked with the owner", so a careful reader would still not read the trial as clean.

H2.why: The summary makes no causal or improvement claim. The trial is stated only as a status, with no link to the itching.

H3.why: The summary does not mention meals or refusals, and the record shows every rated meal fully eaten.

H4.why: No absence or gap is presented as normal or resolved.

H5.quote: itching spans 49 days, first logged Aug 27
H5.why: The band line says 49 days is a floor because the window opens Aug 22 and the record cannot show how long the sign predates it. The summary states 49 days as if it were the full duration, which understates the chronicity.

H6.why: Every claim traces to the band, line-1, the trial line, trial-reading-2 or the confounder line.
